before.evidence: Independently read all six proof steps. The quotient of the two classical forward densities solves the reverse space-time harmonic equation. Its nonnegative local martingales are supermartingales; integrating their event inequalities in x and using complementary positive mixtures summing to one gives true mixture martingales. Near-diagonal Bayes errors tend to zero in local Lebesgue L1 by continuity of the original forward path. Positive p on compact cylinders and the explicitly assumed stopped occupation absolute continuity transfer that convergence to Z; boundedness removes stops. Time averaging then identifies every marginal by continuity, before any auxiliary marginal is used in the endpoint conditional limit. Only afterward do L1 conditional contraction and pi-lambda give Bayes transitions and equal continuous path laws. Natural-filtration stopped compact-test martingales transfer by that equality. Endpoints follow from continuity and finite initial density. No circular auxiliary-marginal argument, initial moment or drift-square hypothesis is introduced. Occupation is an explicit intermediate premise whose applicability remains separately owed.
